svg.title: The Twelve Runes — visual dictionary v01
svg.desc: Approved meaning-to-shape mapping, presented for visual review. Twelve symbols with definitions and unchanged crops of the mana gauge reference.
svg.text: Meaning-to-shape mapping approved · Dictionary drawings awaiting review
ESSENCE · what magic acts upon ACTION · what magic does STRUCTURE · how it is directed or held
Large glyphs: normalized drawings. Small panels: unchanged source crops. Soul and Anchor are optical traces.
Numbers are dictionary indices, not power levels. Circle grammar and cultural variants are developed separately.
